digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock IAM grant on rebar-gerrit-instance-role
propositions: The review-bot container needs Bedrock credentials via the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role, which currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt and has no Bedrock permission.

The grant must be bedrock:Converse and bedrock:ConverseStream (not the InvokeModel pair) because rebar reaches Bedrock through pydantic-ai's BedrockProvider which calls the distinct Converse action namespace; an InvokeModel-only grant yields AccessDeniedException.
Policy simulation confirmed Converse and ConverseStream are implicitDeny under an InvokeModel-only grant, and the role currently has no Bedrock access, making this grant purely additive.

A new file infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf adds one scoped inline policy attached to the existing role without modifying iam.tf, per the single-owner contract, scoped to Claude foundation models and inference profile rather than bedrock:* on *.

IMDS reachability from the container is contested; AC1 empirically probes an IMDSv2 token request, and if unreachable the contingency sets http_put_response_hop_limit=2 keeping http_tokens=required and records the exception in ADR 0046.
Scoped policies must be validated via simulate-principal-policy against the role or a throwaway role, never with a wildcard bedrock:* identity, which hides scoping errors until production.
